caveats.title: The parity comparator was defective until the moment this evidence was taken
caveats.detail: compare-bootstraps.mjs keyed nine of ten categories on the object's NAME alone. Same-name/different-column indexes, changed constraint bodies, rewritten policy USING/WITH CHECK clauses, rewritten functions, retargeted triggers, reordered enums, and RLS enabled-versus-FORCED all compared equal. Ticket 02 rewrote every category to carry the definition and bite-proved it: two probe databases with one deliberate difference per class produce differences=15, exit 1.
caveats.consequence: Every parity claim made before that fix - INCLUDING the entire retained 634-entry evidence set - did not mean what it appeared to mean. The differences=0 results in this bundle are the first taken with a comparator that can see a definition change.

caveats.title: Two tenant gates were green because they could not see

gates.blindSpot: credit_notes, vendor_credits and enterprise_quotes sat in CRM_TABLE_NAMES, so accounting/billing tables were skipped in both modes
.references((): AnyPgColumn => ...) - 12 declarations the regex never matched
matched pgTable( only, so all 83 Build tables declared build.table(...) were invisible
there was no catalog mode at all

caveats.fourthGate: check-tenant-relationships's mid-bootstrap guard read drizzle.__replay, a table only replay-chain-cold.mjs writes. Every database built by db:bootstrap - including every target here - records into drizzle.__drizzle_migrations, so the guard was INERT: the query errored, a .catch swallowed it, and midBootstrap came back null.
caveats.consequence: The PRD's 'tenant relationships: zero actionable' and 'tenant indexes: 745/745' lines describe gates that were not looking at the whole tree.

caveats.title: 22 org-bearing tables have no RLS policy; a cross-tenant read was demonstrated
caveats.measuredBy: the recorder, from pg_catalog, at bundle capture - not copied from a report
caveats.demonstration: As streamline_app (rolbypassrls=false) with app.organization_id='org_probe_A', inside a rolled-back transaction: POLICY-BEARING access_versions rows_visible=1; NO-POLICY inv_customer_shelf_life_rules rows_visible=2 (org_probe_A/10 + org_probe_B/20).
caveats.gateBehaviour: db:verify-rls reported these as EXCLUDED: INVENTORY and exited 0. An exclusion is a statement about who fixes something, never about whether it is exposed.
caveats.stateAsOfThisWriting: Ticket 08 is assigned to fix this and had NOT landed at the time of the measurement above. The 22 is current, not historical.

caveats.title: scratch_boot_a's ACLs were changed after its cold build
caveats.detail: Ticket 03 ran db:bootstrap-role against scratch_boot_a, granting streamline_app DML on public (943/943 tables) and running REVOKE CREATE ON SCHEMA public FROM PUBLIC. No rows and no schema objects changed, and the comparator does not read ACLs.
caveats.consequence: A future ACL-aware comparison of scratch_boot_a against b/c/d will see a delta, and that delta is this, not a bootstrap difference.
